newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Jan 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Jan 10.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following items on the front page of its business section on Friday:
WASHINGTON - Giant Food Inc has sent letters to 2,000 union warehouse employees asking them to cross Teamsters picket lines and return to work.
WASHINGTON - With the big exception of energy, inflation in the prices charged by producers of finished goods all but vanished last year, according to Labour Department statistics.

WASHINGTON - USAir Group Inc has asked its pilots to accept concessions that would allow the company to create a low-cost airline-within-an-airline to compete with Delta Express, Southwest Airlines and other no-frills carriers.
DETROIT - General Motors Corp and Volkswagen AG reached a settlement of GM's lawsuit which alleged that VW stole trade secrets from GM.
